notes.MPW|Total revenue: Consolidated statements of income, 'Total revenues' (FY2024 10-K p.71). FY2023 is net of ~$459M of reserves (mostly Steward) booked as negative revenue; FY2023 straight-line rent revenue was -$127.9M.
notes.MPW|Straight-line rent adjustment (non-c: CFS reconciliation line 'Straight-line rent revenue and other' (FY2024 10-K p.74): non-cash revenue DEDUCTED from net income to reach CFO. The line includes more than straight-line rent.
notes.MPW|Straight-line rent receivable (balan: Face of balance sheet, 'Straight-line rent receivables' (FY2024 10-K p.70: 700,783 / 635,987 $ thousands).
notes.MPW|Loans to tenants (mortgage and other: Mortgage loans + Other loans (BS) + loan-type investments in unconsolidated operating entities (Steward loan, Springstone/Lifepoint loan, Priory term loan, international JV loan) per Note 3 tables. Excludes $1.06-2.05B of financing-lease receivables that share the same CECL allowance.
notes.MPW|Allowance for credit losses on loans: Note 2 'Credit Losses' rollforward (FY2024 10-K p.85; FY2023 10-K p.83). One combined reserve for loans AND financing leases; MPW does not split it. Unfunded commitments are not mentioned. Provision 41.7 / 99.0 / 10.2 / 1,241.0; 'written off or related to instruments sold, repaid, or satisfied' (26.4) / (35.3) / (825.5).
notes.MPW|Straight-line rent / receivable writ: CFS 'Straight-line rent and other write-off'. FY2022 excludes ~$125M SL write-off netted inside the Macquarie sale gain. FY2023 = ~$95M Utah SL write-off + Q4 Steward reserves ($154M billed rent, $224M SL rent, $35M interest) + other tenants (~$95M).
notes.MPW|Revenue from largest single tenant: Steward. The FY2021-FY2023 10-Ks give no dollar or percentage figure: only that Steward, Circle and Prospect 'individually represented more than 10% of our total revenues' (FY2022 10-K p.85; the FY2023 10-K p.96 adds 'excluding reserves recorded during the year'). FY2022 Steward revenue ($427.9M, 27.7%) first appears in the FY2024 10-K concentration table (p.100), after the bankruptcy. FY2024 largest = Circle ($205.6M, 20.7%).
notes.MPW|Impairment charges (real estate and: IS 'Real estate and other impairment charges, net'. FY2024 excludes a further $410.8M equity-interest real estate impairment in the equity-interest line.
notes.OHI|Total equity: Total incl. noncontrolling interest (~5% of total). Parent-only: 3,906.8 / 3,609.4 / 3,574.6 / 4,536.7.
notes.OHI|Straight-line rent adjustment (non-c: CFS reconciliation line 'Straight-line rent and effective interest receivables' (FY2023/FY2024 10-K presentation): non-cash revenue deducted from net income to reach CFO.
notes.OHI|Total debt (sum of all borrowings): Revolver + secured borrowings + senior notes & other unsecured (net).
notes.OHI|Loans to tenants (mortgage and other: Net: mortgage notes + other real estate loans + non-real-estate loans (Note 13). FY2021 = mortgage 835.1 + other investments 469.9.
notes.OHI|Allowance for credit losses on loans: Loans only: real estate loans + non-real estate loans, from Note 9 'Allowance for Credit Losses' rollforward (FY2024 10-K p.F-46). Excludes direct financing leases (0.5 / 2.8 / 2.5 / 1.6) and unfunded loan commitments (0.9 / 0.3 / 7.1 / 3.0), which OHI reports in the same table; all-instrument total 144.5 / 188.4 / 222.2 / 198.6.
notes.OHI|Straight-line rent / receivable writ: Note 5: SL + lease-inducement write-offs on cash-basis moves (36.0 / 119.8) + operator transitions (1.3 / 3.2); FY2023-24 incl. effective-yield interest write-offs.
notes.OHI|Revenue from largest single tenant: Not disclosed in dollars. OHI discloses only the largest operators' share of total revenue: Consulate 9.5% (FY2021, FY2021 10-K p.F-43), LaVie (formerly Consulate) 11.1% (FY2022, FY2022 10-K p.F-51), CommuniCare 11.5% (FY2023, FY2023 10-K p.F-52) - all 'excluding the impact of write-offs' - and CommuniCare 11.8% (FY2024, FY2024 10-K p.F-52) including write-offs. The ratio row shows these disclosed percentages; no dollar amount is implied.
notes.SBRA|Total revenue: Includes resident fees & services (managed senior housing): 155.5 / 186.7 / 236.2 / 284.6. Comparable (rental + interest) revenue: 414.0 / 438.2 / 411.4 / 418.7.
notes.SBRA|Straight-line rent adjustment (non-: CFS 'Non-cash rental and related revenues' (SL rent + intangible amortization + write-offs; positive = write-offs exceeded accrual).
notes.SBRA|Straight-line rent receivable (bala: Not disclosed as a standalone balance (inside 'accounts receivable, prepaid expenses and other assets').
notes.SBRA|Straight-line rent / receivable wri: FY2021 Avamere $25.2M ($44.0M incl. above-market intangible); FY2022 North American $15.6M ($17.1M total). None disclosed FY2023-24.
notes.SBRA|Revenue from largest single tenant: Not disclosed: 'no tenant relationship represented 10% or more of total revenues' in every year.
notes.SBRA|Income (loss) from unconsolidated j: IS line incl. Enlivant JV other-than-temporary impairments of $164.1M (FY21) and $57.8M (FY22).
notes.OHI|Real estate loans interest income: FY2024 10-K consolidated statements of operations (FY2022-FY2024). FY2021 not collected: it falls outside the three years presented in that filing.
notes.OHI|Non-real estate loans interest incom: FY2024 10-K consolidated statements of operations (FY2022-FY2024). FY2021 not collected: it falls outside the three years presented in that filing.
notes.OHI|Miscellaneous income: FY2024 10-K consolidated statements of operations (FY2022-FY2024). FY2021 not collected: it falls outside the three years presented in that filing.
notes.MPW|Largest tenant share of total assets: Share of total assets per the 10-K concentration disclosures (FY2021-FY2023). No FY2024 figure in the data set.
notes.MPW|Investment in loans receivable (CFS): Consolidated statements of cash flows, investing activities, 'Investment in loans receivable': FY2021 from the FY2022 10-K (58,932), FY2022-FY2024 from the FY2024 10-K (207,542 / 250,223 / 420,324), $ thousands. Cash advanced on loans to all borrowers, not only rent-paying tenants.
notes.MPW|Principal received on loans receivab: Consolidated statements of cash flows, investing activities, 'Principal received on loans receivable' (FY2024 10-K label: 'Principal received from sale and repayment of loans receivable'): FY2021 from the FY2022 10-K (1,595,708), FY2022-FY2024 from the FY2024 10-K (53,322 / 501,630 / 214,416), $ thousands.
notes.MPW|Net income (loss), consolidated: Consolidated statements of cash flows, first line 'Net income (loss)' (includes noncontrolling interests; MPW's are small). FY2021 from the FY2023 10-K; FY2022-FY2024 from the FY2024 10-K p.74. Attributable to common: 656.0 / 902.6 / -556.5 / -2,410.3.
notes.OHI|Net income (loss), consolidated: Consolidated statements of cash flows, first line 'Net income' (includes noncontrolling interests in Omega OP units). FY2024 10-K p.F-8. Attributable to common: 416.7 / 426.9 / 242.2 / 406.3.
notes.SBRA|Net income (loss), consolidated: Consolidated statements of cash flows, first line 'Net income (loss)'. Noncontrolling interests are immaterial, so consolidated and attributable-to-common net income are the same to $0.1M.
notes.SBRA|Allowance for credit losses on loan: 'Allowance for loan losses' on loans receivable (FY2024 10-K loans receivable note). Covers loans only; preferred equity investments are separate.

sources.MPW_viceroy_report_date: Viceroy Research, 'Medical Properties (dis)Trust', January 26, 2023 (same date as the timeline entry).
sources.MPW_steward_first_shortfall_date: MPW FY2023 10-K, Note 3: 'Steward delayed paying a portion of its September 2023 rent and paid only $16 million of its required $70 million of rent and interest obligations ... for the 2023 fourth quarter.'
sources.MPW_steward_payments_since_lease_start: MPW FY2023 10-K, Note 3: 'Our initial lease transaction with Steward began in 2016, and they have made approximately $2 billion in rent and interest payments since that time.' Approximate figure.
sources.MPW_wachtell_review: MPW press release, October 14, 2024, 'Medical Properties Trust Releases Findings of Independent Investigation Into Short-seller Allegations': the Board's Audit Committee engaged Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz; investigation completed February 2023; no evidence of round-tripping. 'Independent' is MPW's description.
sources.MPW_steward_share_first_disclosed_in: FY2021, FY2022 and FY2023 10-Ks state only that Steward, Circle and Prospect 'individually represented more than 10% of our total revenues'. The FY2024 10-K concentration table gives Steward FY2022 revenue of $427,912 thousand (27.7%).
sources.OHI_profile_mix: OHI FY2024 10-K facility counts; facility-type abbreviations (SNF, ALF, ILF, MOB) spelled out.
sources.MPW_gain_2022: MPW FY2024 10-K CFS p.74: '(Gain) loss on sale of real estate' (536,755) for FY2022, deducted from net income; 'Net proceeds from sale of real estate' 2,185,574 in investing activities.
sources.OHI_concentration_definition_change: OHI FY2023 10-K p.F-52: CommuniCare 11.5% of FY2023 total revenues 'excluding the impact of write-offs'. OHI FY2024 10-K p.F-52: CommuniCare 11.7% of FY2023 and 11.8% of FY2024 total revenues, 'include the impact of straight-line rent receivable write-offs, lease inducement write-offs and effective yield interest' write-offs. A change of definition, not a restatement.
sources.MPW_portfolio_date: MPW FY2024 10-K Item 1 p.9: 'As of February 28, 2025, our portfolio consisted of 393 properties: 373 facilities are leased to 52 tenants'.
sources.MPW_steward_cash_basis_date: MPW FY2023 10-K Item 1: 'we moved to the cash basis of accounting for our leases and loans with Steward effective December 31, 2023.'
sources.MPW_php_noncash: MPW FY2023 10-K CFS: 'Non-cash revenue from debt and equity securities received' (81,706) deducted from FY2023 net income.
sources.SBRA_no_tenant_10pct: SBRA 10-K Item 1 'Significant Credit Concentrations', FY2021, FY2022, FY2023 and FY2024: 'no tenant relationship represented 10% or more of our total revenues.'

story_facts.MPW_asset_share_source: Steward share of total assets as of Dec 31, 2021 and 2022 (25.1%, 24.2%): FY2022 10-K Item 1 'Significant Tenants', sum of Steward market rows (filed Mar 2023, pre-event). Dec 31, 2023 (19.2%): FY2023 10-K Item 1. The FY2021 10-K itself gave 18.5% of total PRO FORMA gross assets (a different definition).
